sessions.title: Sleep Descent
sessions.short: playbook §C arc A "Sleep Descent". Alpha entry (10 Hz), short hold, then a continuous slope-limited glide 10->2 Hz at ~0.44 Hz/min, then a simultaneous Soft Off of light + audio at ~2 Hz.
sessions.long: Technique: playbook §C arc A "Sleep Descent". Alpha entry (10 Hz), short hold, then a continuous slope-limited glide 10->2 Hz at ~0.44 Hz/min, then a simultaneous Soft Off of light + audio at ~2 Hz. NO wake-up. Goal: fall asleep. Mirrors sleep architecture: alpha -> theta -> delta. Bands: alpha 10 Hz (hold 2 min) -> glide 10->2 Hz (18 min, ~0.44 Hz/min) -> delta ~2 Hz soft-off. SAFETY / CONTRAINDICATIONS: Do NOT use if you have photosensitive epilepsy, a seizure disorder, or a history of photic migraine. Do not use while driving or operating machinery. This is an experiential relaxation aid, not a medical device. Flicker stays <=10 Hz the whole session (never enters the 15-25 Hz photosensitive danger band); warm amber only (no saturated-red strobe, no blue alternation); brightness capped <=30%; LED brightness ramps IN over 10 s and fades to 0 (never an abrupt cut); the delta core sits in the SAFER <3 Hz zone. Format: LED line = time freq duty bright R G B mask Audio = A time freq pan volume mod channel freq_r wave_type Binaural beat is encoded by holding a FIXED freq_r=250 and ramping the LEFT carrier `frequency` (freq_r is NOT interpolatable). Perceived beat = 250 - frequency: car

sessions.title: Power Nap
sessions.short: NASA-style restorative nap. Drop-in 10 Hz -> delta ~3.4 Hz over ~16 min, brief floor/hold, then a deliberate re-ascent 3.4 -> 7 -> 12 Hz to wake before sleep inertia sets in.
sessions.long: Goal: NASA-style restorative nap. Drop-in 10 Hz -> delta ~3.4 Hz over ~16 min, brief floor/hold, then a deliberate re-ascent 3.4 -> 7 -> 12 Hz to wake before sleep inertia sets in. Ends bright and awake — NO fade-out (this is the sanctioned power-nap wake exception, see guidelines §4). Bands: alpha 10 -> delta 3.4 (rest) -> theta 7 -> SMR/low-beta 12; audio beat finishes 14 Hz. Safety (§4): LED flicker CAPPED at 12 Hz — the final 12->14 Hz wake is AUDIO-ONLY (LED held at 12 Hz). Never enters the 15–25 Hz danger band. Brightness capped 50%; LED ramps in over 10 s (0->25%) and fades off over 2 min (4:00->6:00), no abrupt edges. Warm amber (255,100,0) descending -> off during rest -> amber->warm white (255,200,120) on wake. No saturated-red strobe, no red/blue alternation. Audio peaks 65/100. Encoding (§5a): freq_R is NOT interpolatable, so the binaural beat is slid by ramping the LEFT carrier `frequency` with freq_R held FIXED at 255 Hz. Perceived beat = 255 − carrier. Nap goes down then up, so the carrier rises (descent) then falls (re-ascent): beat 10=245, 9.5=245.5, 4=251, 3.9=251.1, 3.4=251.6, 7=248, 12=243, 14=241. Driver: AUDIO isochronic (modulation) — the entrainment beat is carried by ch1 audio; LED is a dim cool->warm wash. SAFETY (guidelines §4): the 14 Hz start is adjacent to the 15-25 Hz photosensitive band, so the LED does NOT flicker (frequency 0 = steady light) until the beat has descended to <=10 Hz at t=5:00. Ramp convention (§5a animate-on-start): the '>' prefix sits on the EARLIER entry and its value is the ramp START; the target is the next same-channel entry's value, swept across the gap. (Putting '>' on the last/later entry never fires.) LED: mask 15 (all 4 legacy zones), duty 50%. Audio: ch1, carrier 200 Hz, pan 0 (center), sine wave, no binaural.

Expressed via the audio `duty` column = 4 with a square gate envelope (env=0). Combined audio + visual at the SAME 40 Hz = best multimodal outcome. Dose: 1 h/day. Single fixed 40 Hz the whole session (no arc/descent). EXPERIMENTAL: the 40 Hz amyloid / disease-modifying claim is CONTESTED; the steady-state entrainment itself is well established. Treat this as experiential, not therapy. Gate depth: the firmware depth work this header used to wait for has landed. Bands: induction alpha 10 Hz; descent 10->5 Hz; deep theta plateau ~5 Hz (the core); return 5->10 Hz. Beat method: BINAURAL only (headphones).
